questions.question: Tus ranked 56th from the bottom and 51st from the top in his class. How many students are there in his class?
questions.solution:
The logic follows here, 

Position of Tus from the top = 51st

Position of Tus from the bottom = 56th

Total number of students in the class = (Position from the top + Position from the bottom) − 1

= (51 + 56) − 1

= 107 − 1

= 106

Hence, the correct answer is **'Option 2'**.

• Sum of positional values = 5 + 21 + 15 + 1 = 42
 
• Code = 42 + 11 = 53

 

**YFMP **

 
• Sum of positional values = 25 + 6 + 13 + 16 = 60
 
• Code = 60 + 11 = 71

 

**RIZB**

 
• Sum of positional values = 18 + 9 + 26 + 2 = 55
 
• Code = 55 + 11 = 66

 
• 

The correct answer is "**option 4"**

questions.question:
What should come in place of ‘?’ in the given series?

90 91 ? 126 190 315
questions.solution:
The logic follows here, 

 
• 90 + 1³ = 91
 
• 91 + 2³ = 99
 
• 99 + 3³ = 126
 
• 126 + 4³ = 190
 
• 190 + 5³ = 315

The term that should come in place of the question mark (?) in the series is **99**.

Hence, the correct answer is "**option 1"**
